# Test portrait

`astronaut.png`: NASA portrait of astronaut Eileen Collins, public domain.
Distributed in scikit-image v0.24.0:
https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/blob/v0.24.0/skimage/data/astronaut.png

Tests place its face at different positions on synthetic backgrounds. No user
media, Stash screenshots or credentials are included in test fixtures.
